description: Fix MATCHES_FIELDS guard selector focus loss caused by unstable guard row keys, and add a compact Monaco-style selector editor with curated suggestions (.Name, .WorkID, .Tags["key"]) while preserving existing required-field validation and exact save payload mapping for matchConfig.inputKey.

context.customerAsk: Fix the guard selector focus-loss regression and add Monaco-style autocomplete/help for MATCHES_FIELDS matchConfig.inputKey, suggesting .Name, .WorkID, and a .Tags["key"] template. Keep validation behavior unchanged (existing required-field errors only).
context.problem: Typing in the MATCHES_FIELDS selector blurs after each character because guard list rows key off formatWorkstationGuardSummary(guard), which changes as inputKey changes. The field is a plain text input with no suggestions, unlike the workstation prompt Monaco editor.
context.solution: Assign stable client-side row identity for guard rows, replace the plain selector input with a compact Monaco-based editor scoped to guard selector completions, suggest .Name, .WorkID, and .Tags["key"] with short descriptions, allow free-form text, and prove focus stability, draft updates, save payload mapping, and unchanged required-field validation with focused component and validation tests.

acceptanceCriteria: Factory authors can type a full MATCHES_FIELDS selector (for example .Tags["_last_output"]) without the editor losing focus or remounting.
Draft updates and workstation save payloads preserve the exact edited matchConfig.inputKey string (aside from existing trim used only for emptiness validation).
The selector editor offers Monaco-style suggestions for .Name, .WorkID, and .Tags["key"] with brief descriptions while accepting arbitrary manual text.
Empty or whitespace-only inputKey still shows the existing required-field error; non-suggested non-empty values do not block save.
No new backend or OpenAPI selector syntax validation is introduced; MATCHES_FIELDS runtime matching behavior is unchanged.
Focused component and validation tests cover focus stability, suggestion acceptance, draft callbacks, and save payload mapping.
Typecheck, lint, and tests pass for all touched UI packages.

userStories.title: Stable guard row identity and continuous selector editing
userStories.description: As a factory operator, I want to type a guard selector continuously so that I can enter values like .Tags["_last_output"] without the field losing focus after each character.
acceptanceCriteria: Guard list rows use stable React identity that does not change when matchConfig.inputKey or other mutable summary fields change
formatWorkstationGuardSummary(guard) is not used as the guard row list key
Multi-character typing into MATCHES_FIELDS matchConfig.inputKey does not blur or remount the active editor
Each typed change updates the editable draft matchConfig.inputKey through onGuardsChange
Guard summary text updates without remounting the row or losing focus
Adding, removing, and editing other guard rows still works
Component tests prove multi-character typing keeps the selector focused and updates the draft with the full string
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Preserve save payload mapping for edited selectors
userStories.description: As a factory operator, I want the selector I typed to save exactly as matchConfig.inputKey so that guard behavior matches what I authored in the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing a MATCHES_FIELDS selector updates guards[index].matchConfig.inputKey on the editable workstation draft via onGuardsChange
The workstation save payload includes the edited selector at guards[index].matchConfig.inputKey with the same string the operator entered
Selectors with quotes and brackets (for example .Tags["_last_output"]) round-trip unchanged through draft to save payload in focused tests
No new normalization is introduced beyond existing trim used only for required-field emptiness checks
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Monaco-style selector autocomplete for MATCHES_FIELDS
userStories.description: As a factory operator, I want selector suggestions while editing MATCHES_FIELDS guards so that I can choose common patterns without memorizing exact syntax.
acceptanceCriteria: The MATCHES_FIELDS selector uses a Monaco-style editor/autocomplete pattern consistent with MonacoPromptEditor (compact height, accessible label and error association)
Autocomplete includes .Name with a short description
Autocomplete includes .WorkID with a short description
Autocomplete includes .Tags["key"] or equivalent placeholder with a short description to replace key with a real tag name
Accepting a suggestion writes the value into matchConfig.inputKey through the same draft path as manual typing
Operators can type arbitrary selector text without being forced to pick a suggestion
Completion items are scoped to guard selectors, not prompt template variables
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: edit a MATCHES_FIELDS guard, open suggestions, accept .Name, and type a custom tag selector

userStories.title: Keep existing validation semantics
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want selector autocomplete to avoid changing save-time validation so this UX improvement does not introduce a new contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Empty or whitespace-only matchConfig.inputKey continues to show the existing required-field validation error on guards[index].matchConfig.inputKey
Non-empty selectors that are not in the suggestion list do not add save-blocking editor diagnostics by themselves
No new backend or OpenAPI validation rule is added for selector syntax
Existing workstation-editable-validation and guard mapping tests continue to pass for the required-field case
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
